name: A leftover site from a crashed earlier run is cleaned before the next run starts
title: SC-13-07-08 A leftover site from a crashed earlier run is cleaned before the next run starts
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given the manifests identify a crashed run and a second run that is still active
When stale-run reclamation runs
Then only the crashed run's site and journey-exclusive identities are removed
And the active run's site, identities and balances remain unchanged
